summary: Phase 1C Turn A backend regression + complementary coverage. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase1c_turn_a_complement.py (14 new tests) alongside the existing test_phase1c_turn_a.py (14 tests + 1 documented skip). Combined suite: 28 passed / 1 skipped against live preview backend. All 15 review-request scenarios verified: (1) markers-library returns exactly 29 seed entries with TERRITORY_MAP_URL fully matching spec (value_source=system_generated, data_type=hyperlink, formula=frozen_territory_map_link, display_text_default='View Agreed Territory Map', requires_frozen_snapshot=True, wrapping=no_wrap, min_font_size=11, eligible_contract_types = {new_franchise, franchise_renewal, territory_amendment}). (2) Strict approval-check dry-run returns ok=True, blockers=[], residual_token_count=0, redaction_verified=True on a PyMuPDF Base14-helv template. (3) /approve on that template flips status=approved, approved_by=admin@creativemojo.co.uk, approved_version set; contract_template_versions row gets frozen_at + approval_report. (4) /approve on missing template → 404; /approve after directly patching Mongo to a bogus pdf_sha256 → 400 with detail.blockers containing 'SHA-256 in object store does not match' (SHA restored afterwards). (5) Auto-retire is scoped to the SAME contract_type — approving a second 'territory_amendment' template retires the first, but a 'licence' template of a different type stays approved. (6) /retire is idempotent + writes a template.retire audit event in contract_template_audit. (7) /versions returns items sorted by version_number desc with frozen_at + markers snapshot. (8) Contracts CRUD: rejects bogus_field with 400 listing offenders; rejects unapproved template refs with 400 mentioning 'approved'; list filters by status/template_id/franchisee_id work; PATCH allow-list enforced (monthly_fee/special_terms/hq_signatory_name persist, status/unknown → 400); updated_at + updated_by move on PATCH; PATCH/DELETE on non-draft (status flipped to 'issued' via Mongo) → 400 with 'only drafts can be edited/deleted'; DELETE draft → 200 + subsequent GET 404. (9) freeze-territory happy path returns snapshot_id (hex uuid) embedded in URL that starts with https://hub.creativemojo.co.uk/agreed-territory/, url_sha256 is 64-hex, frozen_territory_by=admin email; second call → 400 with 'immutable'/'already'; freeze against a synthesised franchisee with empty territory_ids → 400 with 'no territory tiles'. (10) Public snapshot read /api/territory-snapshots/{id}/{token} works unauthenticated, secure_token never leaks in the body (checked both key presence AND raw-text scan), tiles scrubbed to exactly {id, postcode, county, airtable_id}; wrong token AND wrong snapshot_id both → 404 (identical shape, no info leak). (11) Admin /admin/territory-snapshots/{id} returns full doc incl. secure_token + territory_docs; /admin/territory-snapshots?franchisee_id=X list omits territory_docs. (12) Phase 1B regression: Paloma template c12c8ce1-…-fa23 still status='draft' (untouched); evidence-pack POST still returns a valid ZIP containing README.md/manifest.json/source.pdf/preview.pdf/markers.csv; marker library still exactly 29 seed entries.
critical_code_review_comments: contract_lifecycle_routes._run_strict_approval_check re-runs the full preview render on every /approve AND /approval-check call (fresh PyMuPDF open + preview). For a large template this could be several seconds; consider caching the report on the template doc when nothing has changed (source pdf_sha256 + markers hash) so /approval-check is cheap in the UI.

territory_snapshots_routes._link_base_url raises RuntimeError at snapshot-mint time if CONTRACT_LINK_BASE_URL is unset — this would bubble up as a 500 from freeze-territory. Add a startup-time env-var sanity check so ops finds out immediately, not on first freeze.

contracts_routes.DRAFT_EDITABLE_FIELDS allows PATCH of template_id/franchisee_id which re-validates cross-refs but does NOT re-copy template_pdf_sha256/template_version. If HQ swaps template_id post-draft, the contract still carries the OLD template_pdf_sha256 field, which will drift from the new template. Either forbid template_id/franchisee_id in PATCH or refresh those cached fields on change.

contracts_routes.delete_contract_draft removes the draft doc entirely — the associated freeze-territory audit + snapshot rows remain. Not incorrect (snapshots are immutable by design) but ops should know a deleted draft can leave orphan snapshots. Consider a nightly janitor OR an audit note on delete linking to the orphaned snapshot_id.

Public snapshot read intentionally returns identical 404 on wrong-id vs wrong-token — nice. Consider constant-time token comparison (hmac.compare_digest) to close the timing side-channel; currently it's plain '!=' which is fast but leaks the first-differing-byte via response time under a determined attacker.
test_credentials: admin@creativemojo.co.uk / CreativeMojo2026! — login response key is `access_token` (also aliased as `token`).
seed_data_creation: Test file uploads throwaway PyMuPDF-authored templates (Base14-helv, single AGREEMENT_DATE marker) under contract_types {new_franchise, franchise_renewal, licence, licence_renewal, territory_amendment, other}. Some are auto-retired by intra-suite /approve calls — this is the designed side-effect. Non-draft-guard test flips a contract status to 'issued' in Mongo and hard-deletes the row on teardown. SHA-mismatch test mutates pdf_sha256 on a fresh throwaway template and restores it in the finally block. If a franchisee with an empty territory_ids list already exists it's reused; otherwise a synthetic 'TEST-cmp-no-territory-*' franchisee is inserted and removed on teardown. Paloma template c12c8ce1-…-fa23 is only read, never mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two live pytest files cover Phase 1C Turn A end-to-end: test_phase1c_turn_a.py (primary, main agent authored) + test_phase1c_turn_a_complement.py (this iteration). Run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> pytest backend/tests/test_phase1c_turn_a*.py`. Complement file reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env via python-dotenv to do the SHA-mutation and franchisee-synthesis tests — if you re-run in a different environment, ensure that .env is readable. Auto-retire behaviour is real: any /approve call in a shared test session will retire prior approved templates of the SAME contract_type. Turn B/C/D are NOT implemented — do not attempt to test value resolution, personalised PDF rendering, or the issuance wizard. Public snapshot read is intentionally unauthenticated by design; wrong-token and wrong-snapshot-id both return an identical 404.
rca of the issue: N/A — Turn A ships clean. All 15 review-request scenarios pass on first run against the live preview backend. The 1 skipped test is a documented placeholder in the primary file (unacked-substitution fabrication requires an internal hook not exposed via the public API — positive gate is verified via the dry-run + approve tests).
